# Way4Tech SEO and lead-gen action plan

Verified against the repo at `C:/Users/waqas/Documents/github/way4tech-website` on 2026-08-27. Note up front: `dist/` was built today at 18:22-18:24, and `src/pages/contact.astro` was edited at 21:59, so the built contact page is one revision behind source. Every other source file is older than the build, so the rest of `dist/` is current.

## The five that matter most

1. **"Odoo Partner" ships on 583 of 599 pages and is asserted as machine-readable FAQPage JSON-LD** (`src/data/site.ts:341` renders into `dist/index.html`, `/pricing/`, `/resources/`), while `src/data/site.ts:177` puts "ZATCA Phase 2 certified" into the Saudi meta description on 22 pages; both are binary, externally checkable, and neither is evidenced anywhere in the repo.
2. **The stats block claims 500+ deployments and 1000+ custom modules** (`src/data/site.ts:17-21`, on all 583 English pages via the footer) while the site's own build-time-counted author page states 120 modules on the Odoo store, so the site refutes itself by roughly 7x on a number any prospect can check on apps.odoo.com.
3. **All six case studies run the same hardcoded narrative and the same unattributed testimonial** (`src/pages/case-studies/[slug].astro:52-59`, blockquote byte-identical in all 6 built pages, 192 words of `<main>` on uae-hospital), which reads as fabricated proof on exactly the page type a buyer opens before contacting you.
4. **108 service-by-country pages and 90 country-topic pages are majority boilerplate**: measured 8-gram Jaccard across the 18 `/services/odoo-implementation/<country>/` pages is 0.661, and 432 distinct 8-grams appear verbatim on all 18 `/countries/<c>/payroll/` pages against a median of 840 words, which is the doorway-page shape Google's scaled-content policy names.
5. **Every lead depends on a live Odoo session with no fallback, and nothing on the site measures a conversion**: `functions/api/lead.ts:272` authenticates to Odoo on every submit inside a single try/catch, there is no KV, D1, email or queue sink anywhere in `functions/`, and a grep for gtag, dataLayer, Plausible, Clarity or any analytics across `src/` and `astro.config.mjs` returns nothing.

## Fix now (days)

Rows 1, 2, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 13, 14, 16, 17, 24, 25, 27, 29, 31, plus row 3 in its cut-down form.

The order that gets the most out of one working week:

- **Day 1, one commit, all data files.** Strip the partner and ZATCA-certified claims, rewrite STATS, fix `Footer.astro:38` ("All 25 modules" against 39 real module pages), fix `about.astro:14` ("20+ industries" against 37 SOLUTIONS entries), fix `about.astro:37-39` (founded 2016 plus "nine years later" is arithmetically wrong in 2026), fix the three `resources.astro` hrefs, remove the gmail from the contact aside. All in `src/data/site.ts`, `src/components/Footer.astro`, `src/pages/about.astro`, `src/pages/resources.astro`.
- **Day 1, second commit, one line.** `applyBaseStyles: false`. This is the cheapest Core Web Vitals win available and it is a single argument.
- **Day 2.** Product schema `image`, per-product `og:image`, banner dimensions, `ogType` prop. All four live in two files.
- **Day 2.** Confirm the live hostname with `curl -sI` before touching hreflang, then create `public/_headers` and an empty `public/_redirects` so the consolidation work has somewhere to land.
- **Day 3.** Country hub links: service-by-country at `countries/[slug].astro:647` and `:307`, plus the matching blog post. This is a lookup against data you already have and it unblocks the two most under-linked page groups at once.
- **Day 3.** Delete the case-study blockquote and the shared narrative. Even before you write real ones, six pages saying nothing beats six pages saying the same fabricated thing.
- **Day 4.** Analytics in all three layouts, `generate_lead` on the success branch, `/thank-you/` page. Then the durable lead sink in `functions/api/lead.ts`, which is the only genuinely urgent backend change.
- **Day 5.** Mobile: sticky action bar, unhide WhatsApp, prefill the `wa.me` text, skip link, reduced-motion block.

Rebuild and deploy at the end of day 1, not at the end of the week, because the contact-page a11y fix is already sitting unbuilt in source.

## Already working. Do not rebuild these

Several auditors flagged things as missing that are present in this repo. Check before you touch them.

- **The contact form already has `for`/`id` pairs, `autocomplete`, `inputmode` and a fixed service-select prefill.** Three auditors reported all six fields unlabelled with zero autocomplete. That was true of `dist/contact/index.html`, which is a build from 18:23 today. `src/pages/contact.astro` was edited at 21:59 and already contains `for="lead-name"` through `for="lead-message"`, `autocomplete="name|organization|email|tel"`, and the `serviceField.value = match.value` prefill that replaces the duplicate-hidden-input bug. **The fix is a rebuild, not a rewrite.** Verify with `find src -newer dist/index.html`, which returns exactly that one file.
- **`heroImg` already exists** at `products/[slug].astro:180`. You do not need to compute it; you need to use it.
- **Screenshot images already carry `width`/`height`** from `module-media.ts`. Only the `banner` field lacks `w`/`h`, and only because `ModuleMedia.banner` is typed as a plain `string` while `ModuleShot` carries dimensions. Add the two fields, do not rebuild the media pipeline.
- **First-touch attribution is fully built and good.** sessionStorage-backed, external-referrer check, every access try/caught, `setAttribute('value')` so hidden fields survive `form.reset()`, and UTM values mapped to native `utm.mixin` fields in `functions/api/lead.ts:339-350` rather than dumped into a text blob. The `?service=`/`?country=`/`?source=` params are already emitted correctly from 30 templates, including the Arabic and Turkish CTAs. What is missing is the analytics event and the durable sink, not the attribution layer.
- **BreadcrumbList already exists on 581 of 599 pages** with correct sequential positions and a matching visible trail. Only the 6 hub indexes and the 6 case-study pages need it added.
- **Taxonomy-driven related blocks already exist** in `modules/[slug].astro:10`, `integrations/[slug].astro:14`, `products/[slug].astro:164-166` and `industries/[slug].astro:45`. The gap is cross-silo linking, not the related-item machinery.
- **The nine real hreflang pairs are correctly reciprocal in both directions.** The work is extending the pattern, not fixing it.
- **The verification system works.** `COUNTRY_DETAIL_REVIEWED = '2026-08-22'` renders on 126 pages, per-fact `verified` badges render in all three languages, and no regulatory claim is ever placed in structured data (the code says why, at `countries/[slug].astro:283-285`). Do not loosen the rule in the `country-detail.ts` header; there is a backlog behind a correctly working flag.
- **The author page is exemplary and the honest product treatment is right.** `/author/waqas-riasat/` counts everything at build time and links every listing for independent verification, and `/products/way4tech-logistics/` plainly says it is not on the Odoo Apps Store. Those are the models to copy, not to replace.
- **Arabic RTL is done properly**, including IBM Plex Sans Arabic, `unicode-bidi: isolate`, `<bdi dir="ltr">` around phone numbers, and the Turkish `text-transform` guard for the i/İ problem at `BaseTr.astro:126-129`.
- **The mega panels use `visibility: hidden`,** so all 106 desktop nav links are correctly out of tab order. Do not "fix" that.
- **Zero JavaScript bundles ship.** `ls dist/assets/*.js` returns nothing. Keep it that way when adding analytics; use a single async snippet, not a framework.
- **`public/_redirects` does not exist at all.** One auditor described it as "empty, 0 bytes". You will be creating it, not editing it.

Two auditor numbers were wrong and would mislead you if you acted on them. `/solutions/hospital-management/` is **166** words of `<main>`, not 1,026; the larger figure counted header and footer chrome. And `/blog/odoo-community-vs-enterprise-2026/` is **395 source words**, not 1,276; it is the thin one, and it is the one to delete.

## What could not be verified without Node.js

- **No build was run.** Every fix that changes generated output, in particular `applyBaseStyles: false` collapsing to a single stylesheet, is reasoned from the source and the two emitted CSS files, not observed. The rule-set comparison is solid (638 rules in A, 677 in B, zero A-only), but confirm the single-stylesheet result after the first rebuild.
- **No Lighthouse, no CrUX, no field data.** Every LCP, CLS and INP statement in this plan is a mechanism argument from the markup, not a measurement. The unsized banners will cause layout shift; how much is unknown.
- **No network access was used.** I did not resolve DNS, so I cannot say whether `way4tech.com` or `www.way4tech.com` serves 200. Row 31 is a two-command check you must run yourself, and it gates the hreflang work.
- **The Odoo partner directory was not checked.** Row 1 assumes the claim is unevidenced because nothing in the repo evidences it. If the listing exists, the fix is to cite it in `sameAs` and on `/about/`, not to remove the claim.
- **Search Console data is absent.** Which of the 599 URLs are actually indexed, and whether the 108 service-by-country pages are already sitting in "Crawled, currently not indexed", is the one dataset that would settle how urgent row 4 is. Pull the Index Coverage report before committing to the large rewrite.
- **`functions/api/lead.ts` was read, not exercised.** The failure mode described in item 5 is read off the control flow; I did not submit a test lead or confirm the current state of the Odoo credentials.
